book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_flu: All three flutes share one job: a riff distracts nearby creepers and interrupts attacks from $(l:the_hamster_life/redstone_fever)<dark_green><b>fevered hamsters</>. Pick whichever color best matches your shirt. Or your hat. Whatever.

Look directly at your hamster and play the flute to coax it into jumping onto your shoulder. Successful mounts train that hamster to be faster next time.$(br2)There's also a $(l:advanced_rodentry/musical_rodentry)<dark_green><b>musical secret</>.$(br2)Recipes →
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_rin: When two players both wear an <dark_green><b>Acorn Ring</>, their pets will not target each other, either player, or animals those players own—even in $(l:advanced_rodentry/aggression_states)<dark_green><b>Menace</> mode ($(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configurable</>).$(br2)Both rings must stay worn; yours also stops you hitting your pets.
Wear the ring in your <b>offhand</> or a supported <b>Accessories</>, <b>Trinkets</>, or <b>Curios</> ring slot. Taking off either ring ends the contract without starting a fight.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.aggressio: $(br)Hamster on the attack? Try feeding it a $(l:accessories/flowers)<dark_green><b>flower</> to wipe its memory and calm it down. Another bite while it's calm enables <b>Pacifist</> mode.$(br)<gold><b>{NEUTRAL_ITEM}</> = <i>'factory reset'</> back to neutral.$(br)<gold><b>{MENACE_ITEM}</> activates <b>Menace</> mode. It will hunt monsters and anything else you $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configure</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.ahp_comma: Allows admins to apply fever and cure the nearest hamster. You can append an entity selector for a group of hamsters.$(br2)You will not receive Fever-related advancements when using the commands.

Spawns random distinct hamsters. Set <b><count></> to a number, or use <b>all</> to spawn EVERY possible combination.$(br2)Warning: <b>all</> will spawn {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} hamsters, and can <red><b>permanently ruin</> your world.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.feeding.p: Hold any $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configured hamster food</> to get their attention, even during an $(l:advanced_rodentry/aggression_states)<dark_green><b>active fight</>. Wild hamsters follow anyone; tamed hamsters only follow their owner. A valid fight may resume when the snack leaves.$(br2)Only $(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>taming food</> and $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>shoulder treats</> make them beg. The rest still works. They just retain some dignity.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.flowers.p: Stumbled upon a <gold><b>Flower</>? <b>Sneak + right-click</> your hamster with it. It's called fashion. Look it up. Click again to cycle the position. Use shears or the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to remove it.$(br2)<b>Careful!</> If you forget to sneak, you will change their $(br)   $(l:advanced_rodentry/aggression_states)<dark_green><b>Aggression State</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hide_and_: Your hamster may occasionally jump into a nearby bush or storage block.$(br2)The hiding place will occasionally jiggle, make noise and release particles. Subtlety was rejected during testing.$(br2)Timing and hiding spots$(br)   are $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configurable</>.

$(br)Follow the faint golden pixie dust trail toward the hiding place, then <b>interact with</> or try to <b>break</> that block before your hamster gets board.$(br2)Find your hamster in time and it will give you a gift. Fail, and it will sulk for a bit before following you again.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.musical_r: Sacrifice your precious disc to a hell-bound merchant, and it will be returned to you in cinematic orchestral form.
Toss it into the pool at the end of time, and the powers that be will reject its moist tones, spitting it back out in low-fi form.

I know you're wondering: what happens when a $(l:the_hamster_life/redstone_fever)<dark_green><b>fevered hamster</> is cured with the $(l:accessories/acorn_flute)<dark_green><b>Acorn Flute</>, and then launched at a walking lightning bomb that is <b>actively distracted</> by the flute sound? Same here.
<b>Content Creators ↓</>$(br2)Did you know, all four songs are <b>fully licensed</> and safe for YouTube & Twitch monetization?$(br2)Feel free to feature them in your videos!
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.redstone_: Some hamsters have inhaled a little bit too much redstone dust.$(br2)Glowing red eyes, scarred fur, trembling, angry snorts, and an immediate interest in your ankles are the usual symptoms. Food will not help. Even waving cheese in their face does nothing.

$(br)To distract them, play a riff with an $(l:accessories/acorn_flute)<dark_green><b>Acorn Flute</>. Then help them recover in clear sunlight above the dusty depths.$(br2)Spawn, cure, aggression, and flute rules are $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>configurable</>.
adorablehamsterpets.items.dancingMusicDi: Case-insensitive key words matched against a music disc's name, description, translation key or lore. If a keyword from a song appears in both of these lists, the 'swaying' list takes priority over this list.
Here's where you control what types of music discs cause hamsters to dance, and what types of dances they do.
adorablehamsterpets.items.slowDancingMus: Case-insensitive key words matched against a music disc's name, description, translation key or lore. If a keyword from a song appears in both of these lists, this list takes priority over the 'bouncing' list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFlute.desc: Set how far the music carries, how much trouble it interrupts, and how quickly hamsters learn the recall signal.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteAntiS: Minimum wait (in ticks) between flute uses. 20 ticks = 1 second. It's only one half of a second by default because I didn't want to punish your shaky aim if you intended to summon your hamster but you missed and played a normal riff instead. But if server members have decided the flute is actually a maraca, feel free to crank it up.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteAudio: Maximum distance in blocks at which players can hear an Acorn Flute. This setting is purely related to audio and has nothing to do with the effects that it has. The volume of the audio is dynamically adjusted based off your distance from the source.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteCreep: Choose whether flute riffs calm every creeper, or only charged creepers. Is it OP? No. No, it's not. Don't even say that.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteEffec: Radius in blocks where a flute riff distracts creepers and interrupts Redstone Fever attacks.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteMount: Maximum distance in blocks for calling an owned hamster to an open shoulder or head slot. You can call them even if they are sitting or sleeping. Beyond this range they cannot hear you. Allegedly.

Successful flute-assisted mounts needed for full attunement. Hamsters initially have to think about what you're asking for, so it at first, it takes ~3 seconds for them to respond. Keep training, and they will eventually respond within a single second.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornFluteRiffL: Percentage of the current riff that must finish before another flute use layers a new riff over it. With the default of 80%, playing during a riff's first 80% cuts it short and starts a new one; playing during the final 20% layers the new riff on top while the first one finishes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingOnlyPr: If true, Acorn Ring contracts only cover hamsters. If false, they cover all conventionally owned pets.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingPreven: If true, wearing an Acorn Ring prevents your direct attacks from damaging pets owned by another ring wearer.
If true, wearing an Acorn Ring prevents your direct attacks from damaging pets you own.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingSettin: Configure who and what the Acorn Ring protects.
adorablehamsterpets.main.commissionedFea: Specialized, unofficial mechanics funded by supporters that don't necessarily fit the theme of the mod. Purposefully tucked away in the config to ensure most people don't notice them.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableOneMinute: For testing only. Makes infected hamsters require 60 seconds of valid sunlight instead of the configured number of days.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRedstoneF: Controls whether Redstone Fever can appear. Turning this off also cures every infected hamster.
Allows infected hamsters to occasionally race in tight circles. Perfectly normal medical behavior.
Allows infected hamsters to recover by spending enough time in direct sunlight above the depths where Redstone Fever naturally appears.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableSurfaceSu: Allow healthy wild hamsters to randomly and instantly become infected with Redstone Fever when first approached by a Survival or Adventure player. The dice gets rolled once per hamster even if they are approached again later. So a hamster that doesn't turn on you after you approach can be trusted.
Configure the commissioned Feather Yeeting status effect.
adorablehamsterpets.main.featherYeetingC: Percentage removed from a hamster's base throw cooldown when the throwing player has Feather Yeeting. 0% preserves the base cooldown; 100% removes it.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFever.d: Control how Redstone Fever behaves, from sunlight treatment to who infected hamsters attack and how often they burst with energy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverAt: Allows infected hamsters to attack nearly all types of nearby living entities. Accessible Survival and Adventure players remain first on the hit list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverMa: Longest possible duration of an energy burst (in seconds).
Longest possible wait (in seconds) before another energy burst begins.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverMi: Shortest possible duration of an energy burst (in seconds).
Shortest possible wait (in seconds) before another energy burst begins.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverSu: Number of Minecraft days an infected hamster must spend in direct sunlight to be cured. Progress pauses underground, in the shade and at night.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverTa: Maximum range in blocks at which an infected hamster can acquire a target.
adorablehamsterpets.main.surfaceSurprise: Percentage chance that an undecided hamster contracts Redstone Fever on first approach.
Distance in blocks at which the first eligible player causes the dice roll.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ultimateNightma: Optional surface Redstone Fever settings. The settings here are subordinate to the global Redstone Fever feature toggle.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.playersWhoHaveSee: A list of players who have already seen the missing guidebook warning. This helps ensure that each player sees the warning only once. It was broken for a while, but it is fixed as of v3.7.0.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeFluteTrai: Show whether a hamster is Untrained, Learning, Responsive, or Attuned to the Acorn Flute. The more in sync, the faster the hamster will respond when you use the flute to call it to your shoulder.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeRedstoneF: Show Severe, Recovering, or Nearly Cured while looking at a fevered hamster.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.acornRingLo: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find an Acorn Ring in uncommon chests. Rolled independently from armor and other accessories.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.allowedReds: Dimension IDs or #dimension tags allowed to produce natural Redstone Fever cases. Just the overworld by default.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableNatur: Allows newly spawned wild hamsters underground to have a chance of starting with Redstone Fever. Hamsters created with spawn eggs are excluded so you don't jump scare yourself.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.maximumReds: Highest Y coordinate where hamsters can become infected upon spawning. They must also be above this level before sunlight can cure them. The default is Y 16 because it's the highest point where you might find Redstone ore.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.redstoneFev: Percentage chance for an otherwise eligible wild cave hamster to spawn fevered. Default: 50%; range: 0–100%.

Control where wild hamsters can naturally spawn with Redstone Fever and how often it happens. The global 'Enable Redstone Fever' toggle in Main has final authority. If it's disabled there, these settings won't do anything.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.requireReds: When enabled, hamsters can only become infected upon spawning if they spawn in biomes that are included in this mod’s '#adorablehamsterpets:is_cave' tag. The other height, darkness, dimension and natural-spawn checks still apply.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: Complete the Acorn Music Disc ritual with the same hamster you helped cure. Poetic. Legendary.
Cure a fevered hamster with prolonged direct sunlight and good music. Medical licensing remains pending.
Find your hamster before time runs out. Apparently this counts as responsible pet ownership.
Discover a hamster suffering from Redstone Fever. Apparently prolonged redstone exposure has side effects.
config.adorablehamsterpets.condition.one: Unavailable while 'One-Minute Cure Debug Mode' is TRUE.
config.adorablehamsterpets.condition.sur: Only available when 'Surface Surprise' is TRUE.
message.adorablehamsterpets.flute_move_c: Move closer. It's a tiny ball of fur, not a ninja.
Can distract explosive enemies and summon small friends.
tooltip.adorablehamsterpets.acorn_flute_: The warm variant. Looks dangerous. Probably isn't.
All the colors. The color committee approved everything.
The cool variant. Smells like mint and lavender.
tooltip.adorablehamsterpets.acorn_ring.h: Stops your pets from attacking another ring wearer's pets.
Also keeps you from accidentally hitting your own pets.
tooltip.adorablehamsterpets.armor_visibi: The global Armor Visuals setting can still hide all armor.
Armor visuals are currently disabled globally.
tooltip.adorablehamsterpets.music_disc_a: A fluty groove etched into the carcass of a dead acorn.
